assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: native 32px pixel-art ground material atlas for a top-down anime zombie co-op game. Existing image is palette reference ONLY, deliberately replace its noisy texture with much quieter deliberate pixel clusters. Produce square opaque image, exactly 2x2 equal cells, NO gutters, NO borders, NO labels, no perspective. Top left: near-flat dark slate asphalt, base #252e34 with at most 5 tiny low-contrast clusters, identical dark undetailed perimeter all around. Top right: same asphalt base and perimeter, at most one tiny muted scuff. Bottom left: slightly lighter muted grey concrete maintenance slab, base approximately #39434a, almost flat with sparse broad low-contrast pixel clusters, NO cracks. Bottom right: warm desaturated grey-brown service paving, base approximately #494c48, a subtle large 32 logical px slab pattern, no gravel or speckle. All images 32x32 logical pixel scale magnified uniformly, crisp square block pixels; nearest-neighbor feel, no smooth lighting. Tileable edges within each material, no painted separated squares or bevels. Ground must recede behind existing actors and muzzle/blood. No grass, plants, objects, signage, road paint, curb, raised edge, walls, blood, character. Quiet material swatches, not a scene. Keep dark moody existing palette but fewer, much larger intentional pixel clusters.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent top-down oblique anime pixel-art environmental frontage module sheet for an editable tile map. Design OPTION A: urban service street leading to utility station and evacuation checkpoint. Reference image is existing game's environment palette and camera ONLY: simplify the noise greatly, don't copy the entire scene. Create ONE wide landscape PNG RGBA with exactly 2 columns x2 rows, each cell containing ONE long, shallow orthographic frontage module, about160x32 logical pixels shown enlarged uniformly, seen from above with front wall facing screen-down. Each module width5 times its height, fits completely inside its own cell, clear transparent gutters. No ground/asphalt surrounding these modules; genuine alpha.
Top left: small muted teal shuttered corner repair shop, tan plaster, one narrow window, simple rust awning.
Top right: DISTINCT compact electricity utility frontage, blue-grey equipment-room wall, turquoise electrical cabinet and small yellow lightning symbol, copper conduits, one vent, asymmetrical silhouette. No standalone objective terminal; this is context behind the game's separate console.
Bottom left: red-brown brick service/loading frontage, shutter door with ochre trim, one small upper window, one inset loading recess.
Bottom right: DISTINCT evacuation CHECKPOINT context frontage, muted blue folded canopy and an ivory medical cross plaque, side service hatch and one amber beacon, no closed barrier and no gate spanning the route. Existing mission gate is separate and must remain visibly stateful.
All four same native pixel size/perspective/value, no mirrored duplicate modules. Restrained dark slate, tan, ochre, desaturated teal; warm landmark accents small and purposeful. Crisp pixel clusters, no smooth gradients/3D perspective/photoreal texture. No characters, vehicles, crates, detached fences, text/words/numbers, grid, labels, watermarks. Keep detail low enough to read beside48px actors. Art components for map assembly, NOT a full map painting.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent environment frontage modules for native 32px tile game. OPTION B utility SERVICE YARD. Reference is existing warehouse for muted industrial materials only, avoid pitched giant roof/isometric angles. Generate ONE wide sheet, exactly2columns x2rows, four DISTINCT shallow long frontage sprites with transparent gutters and true alpha, no floor around them. Orthographic top-down oblique camera with front wall facing screen-down, about128x32 logical pixels enlarged uniformly; width about4times height. All same scale/value/pixel size.
Top left: dark grey utilitarian workshop wall, small windows, teal roller door, two vertical steel pillars, flat parapet roof.
Top right: ELECTRICAL SUBSTATION context wall, large teal switchgear cabinets, restrained yellow lightning emblem, copper cable ducts and insulator cluster integrated in shallow wall; no separate playable console.
Bottom left: broad industrial loading-door facade, charcoal corrugated shutter, aged warm ochre lintel, small red/brown side inset and ventilation ducts. Distinct silhouette from workshop.
Bottom right: service-gate/checkpoint CONTEXT wall section, red-orange service canopy, ivory arrow pictogram and amber hazard beacon, side kiosk, no barrier spanning playable street and no duplicate closed mission gate.
Keep dark industrial slate, steel grey, desaturated teal, tiny warm ochre accents. Low-grain crisp intentional anime pixel art matching48px game actor; limited pixel clusters, no photoreal grit, no smooth gradients, no exaggerated perspective. No people, cars, crates, props extending onto floor, text, letters, numbers, labels, frames, grid, checkerboard. Standalone native module source sheet for a tile map, not a scene.
